description: List dependencies that can be added to the generated Maven or Gradle build. These dependencies are managed by the project's Spring Boot version and therefore do not require a dependency version. Use the optional query to narrow the result. Successful calls record MCP usage and activity for this project.

projectId.description: The project ID returned by startProject

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text contained in the coordinates

name: listAvailableDependencies

userProjectChanged.description: Present only once when the project appears to have been changed by the user since the preceding MCP call within the last two hours

title: List available project dependencies
